title: SimMotionSet
description: Harness channel, OUTSIDE the vehicle contract (ADR-024). Published by the backend to v1/sim/{vehicle_id}/motion/set; the simulator receives it and calls its own set_motion(), so the publisher of state/* stays the simulator identity and ADR-013 holds. Never routed to an actuator: motion is a read-only domain in the vehicle contract and has no command topic.

speed_kph.description: Ceiling is the director's-desk ceiling, not a VF9 spec figure: wide enough for every S2/S3 scenario, tight enough that a unit mix-up (m/s read as km/h) is rejected instead of silently published.

gear.description: Absent or null means pick for me: D when speed_kph > 0, P when it is 0 — the same convention as SimulatorRuntime.set_motion(gear=None), so the on-screen slider and the console `speed 45` produce the same state.
